notes: The petition is fiction; the contract is not. CREATOR 0x70c6C4fcaAb11151FCEDb32eaaC3431547193A0a is the requester's wallet, disclosed in README and MedallionHook NatSpec. FareToken is a self-contained ERC-20 with a zero-argument constructor, burn and allowance-based burnFrom. MedallionHook collects 2% of each trade's ETH side as PoolManager currency-0 claims; non-ETH pools are fee-free. Swap callbacks make no external calls except claim minting and never push ETH. Only swaps increase totalFees. creatorEntitlement=min(totalFees,1.64 ETH); burnable=totalFees-creatorEntitlement-burnSpent. Recouped is emitted once when totalFees reaches the cap. Permissionless retire() releases exactly 1.64 ETH to CREATOR once, atomically with verifying medallion #447 is at 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD. The current NFT holder must approve the hook unless the NFT is already at DEAD. Transfer or payout failure reverts the entire transaction. creatorPaid is zero or exactly the cap, and the recipient remains CREATOR even if the NFT changes hands. Retirement emits CreatorPaid and the pinned LastFare text/hash. Surplus can fund permissionless burnIMD() before or after retirement without consuming the creator reserve. IMD burning means purchasing IMD and transferring it to DEAD, not calling an IMD burn function. Callers receive no assets or tip. Burn routes are fixed ETH/IMD pools: POOL4 (10000,60,POOL4_HOOK) and plain (10000,200,zero hook). Batches are automatic, at most 0.05 ETH normally or 0.01 ETH in plain fallback, minimum 0.002 ETH, with five blocks from deployment or the last successful burn. Normal mode requires valid open-market POOL4 views and a successful burn within 50400 blocks; the first burn uses plain fallback. The anchor starts from a valid POOL4 tick or zero; fallback and pokeAnchor move it toward plain spot by at most 200 ticks per elapsed block. It is a bounded spot reference, not a TWAP. Only spot below reference minus tolerance is rejected: 300 ticks for normal plain, 150 otherwise. Minimum output is the greater of callerMinOut and the rounded-up 96% reference quote. Zero or partial fills revert. The sole constructor argument is the literal Sepolia PoolManager address above. Permissions are exactly 0x00CC, validated at construction; the deployed address must encode those low 14 bits. There is no beforeInitialize. NFT 0x9C8fF314C9Bc7F6e59A9d9225Fb22946427eDC03, IMD 0xD34a99Bc0f67aE1bbd63C660e6d0b0dd03E263B7 and POOL4_HOOK 0xc6C965Bd164c483e87d0B550671798e9A3602840 are fixed mainnet-only addresses. On Sepolia, after prerequisite guards, retire() reverts MedallionUnavailable, plain burnIMD() falls back and reverts MissingPool, and viaPool4 reverts Pool4Unavailable. Offline tests use vm.etch mocks at those addresses. The launch pool is native ETH as currency0 and FARE447 as currency1, distinct from the IMD burn pools. Its static LP fee is 3000 and tick spacing 60. initialPrice is decimal sqrtPriceX96=1000*2^96, representing the existing assumption of 1 ETH = 1,000,000 FARE447. The hook uses a transient reentrancy lock at literal slot 1. Neither contract has an owner, admin, setter, pause, proxy, upgrade or sweep. This manifest is a technical description; deployment policy is separately versioned.
